en.topic_title: HKFP Lens: ‘Love at last sight’ – bidding farewell to Hong Kong’s modernist General Post Office after 50 years
en.topic_summary:
When the General Post Office was built in Central half a century ago, conservationists mourned the loss of the building it replaced. 



Exterior of the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The old General Post Office was a marvel of Edwardian architecture: sweeping archways and granite veranda pillars beneath a distinctive façade of rose-coloured Amoy brick – the gold standard for durability on the storm-lashed South China coast.



The GPO’s ground-floor entrance at 2 Conn
